title: 薄明のラジオ、あるいは静かな嘘
author: 夜野しずく

en.title: Twilight Radio, or a Quiet Lie
en.premise: Living in the shadow of my perfect twin sister as her "substitute," I found solace in an unidentified private radio station that broadcasts only at 4:00 AM. Through letters that were never meant to be delivered, I begin to share a secret, private world with the boy behind the microphone. Without ever knowing his name or his face, it is only within that blue light before dawn that I can truly be myself.

zh.title: 微光电台，亦或是静谧的谎言
zh.premise: 作为完美双胞胎姐姐的影子，一直以“替身”身份活着的我，唯有在凌晨四点才会播出的身份不明的私人电台里，找到了心灵的寄托。通过本不该送达的信件，我开始与电台的主播少年，共同度过一段不为人知的秘密时光。在不知道彼此姓名与容貌的情况下，唯有在那黎明前的青色微光中，我才能成为真正的“我”。
